from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,time,json,signal
root=Path(__file__).parent
app=root/'Filter Example.app'
log=root/'app.log'
def run(args,name,timeout=30):
 r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 (root/name).write_text(r.stdout+r.stderr)
 r.check_returncode()
 return r.stdout
launcher=None;pid=None
try:
 launcher=subprocess.Popen(['open','-n','-W','--stdout',str(log),'--stderr',str(log),'--env','WATERUI_LOG=info',str(app)])
 deadline=time.monotonic()+30
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  processes=subprocess.check_output(['ps','-axo','pid=,command='],text=True,timeout=10)
  for line in processes.splitlines():
   parts=line.strip().split(None,1)
   if len(parts)==2 and parts[1]==str(app/'Contents/MacOS/Filter Example'):pid=int(parts[0])
  if pid and log.exists() and 'effect frame' in log.read_text():break
  if launcher.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('application exited before first frame')
  time.sleep(.2)
 else:raise RuntimeError('no effect frame within 30 seconds')
 (root/'pid.json').write_text(json.dumps({'pid':pid}))
 run(['osascript','-e',f'tell application "System Events" to set frontmost of first process whose unix id is {pid} to true'],'activate.txt')
 run(['sudo','-n','powermetrics','--samplers','tasks','--show-process-energy','-i','1000','-n','5'],'visible-power.txt',15)
 capture=subprocess.run(['screencapture','-x',str(root/'visible.png')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 (root/'visible-capture.txt').write_text(capture.stdout+capture.stderr)
 run(['osascript','-e',f'tell application "System Events" to set visible of first process whose unix id is {pid} to false'],'hide.txt')
 marks={'hidden_at':time.time(),'frames_at_hide':log.read_text().count('effect frame')}
 run(['sudo','-n','powermetrics','--samplers','tasks','--show-process-energy','-i','5000','-n','8'],'hidden-power.txt',50)
 marks.update(hidden_end=time.time(),frames_at_hidden_end=log.read_text().count('effect frame'))
 run(['pmset','-g','assertions'],'assertions.txt')
 run(['ps','-p',str(pid),'-o','pid,time,%cpu,rss,state,command'],'hidden-process.txt')
 run(['osascript','-e',f'tell application "System Events" to set visible of first process whose unix id is {pid} to true','-e',f'tell application "System Events" to set frontmost of first process whose unix id is {pid} to true'],'restore.txt')
 deadline=time.monotonic()+10
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  if log.read_text().count('effect frame')>marks['frames_at_hidden_end']:break
  time.sleep(.1)
 else:raise RuntimeError('no frame after restoring window')
 capture=subprocess.run(['screencapture','-x',str(root/'restored.png')],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 (root/'restore-capture.txt').write_text(capture.stdout+capture.stderr)
 marks.update(restored_at=time.time(),frames_after_restore=log.read_text().count('effect frame'))
 (root/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(marks,indent=2))
finally:
 if pid:
  try:os.kill(pid,signal.SIGTERM)
  except ProcessLookupError:pass
 if launcher:
  try:launcher.wait(timeout=10)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:launcher.terminate();launcher.wait(timeout=5)
